report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: 0.1% error rate, p95 78ms, OK traces, INFO 200 logs, no pool waiters or dependency timeouts. This contradicts the alert and does not establish any taxonomy cause. Downstream services (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) have no observations, so the fault cannot be localized. Handing off for downstream evidence.
